Lessons:
- Any row lookup by message id must carry the full identity: kind (= recipient), origin and key. The live unique index is (kind, dedupe_origin, dedupe_key), and the delivered ledger is keyed by recipient. A same-id resend makes a second row. An expiry "NOT delivered, resend" notice must check for a live or still-held sibling copy, or a resend double-delivers.
- Run each mutant alone and keep the logs. shared-build `--then` stops at the first failure, so batched mutants hide kills. Reviewers WILL ask for receipts. Generate mutants as patch files (edit, then git diff > patch, then git apply -R) and apply them from a script.
- Local `harness checks` never exited 0 on the loaded fleet machine: each run failed a different tmux or timing test, and each passed alone. Say so plainly, and rely on CI plus pr-freeze. Never claim harness passed.
- The OMP pij_send tool printed `queued` for every receipt. The fix: receiptVerdict in core/daemon-wire.ts.
